title: Trainee Engineer (Civil, Electrical and Mechanical)
qualification: Candidates must have qualified in GATE 2025 or GATE 2026 and possess a valid score in the corresponding Engineering paper. Applicants who appeared in both GATE examinations must enter their best score. NHPC will use the submitted GATE score for shortlisting candidates for Group Discussion and Personal Interview. || Important: Only GATE 2025 or GATE 2026 normalised marks out of 100 will be considered. Scores from any other GATE year are not valid for this recruitment. Candidates must enter their correct GATE registration number and score while applying.
salary: The NHPC Trainee Engineer Salary 2026 is based on E2 Grade with a pay scale of Rs.50,000–1,60,000 under the IDA pattern. Selected candidates will receive this pay scale during the one-year training period. On successful completion of training, they will be absorbed as Engineers in the same pay scale, with a probation period of one year. The approximate annual emoluments for a new employee are Rs.16–17 lakh. || In addition to basic pay, selected employees will be eligible for Dearness Allowance, House Rent Allowance, Cafeteria Allowance, Performance Related Pay, medical facilities and social security benefits such as Provident Fund, pension and gratuity according to the applicable company rules. || Note: The approximate annual emoluments of Rs.16–17 lakh are not the same as the monthly in-hand salary. Actual take-home pay will depend on applicable allowances and deductions.
age_limit: NHPC provides upper age relaxation to eligible reserved-category candidates and other specified groups under the applicable Government of India guidelines. || Candidates claiming age relaxation must possess valid supporting certificates in the prescribed format. The additional Jammu and Kashmir domicile provision applies to eligible candidates who were ordinarily domiciled in the state between 1 January 1980 and 31 December 1989.
application_fee: Important: Additional bank or processing charges, including GST where applicable, must be borne by the applicant. The registration fee is non-refundable. || Candidates applying separately for NHPC and NHDC Trainee Engineer vacancies in Electrical or Mechanical disciplines must submit separate applications and pay the applicable fee for each application, unless exempted.
selection_process: The NHPC Trainee Engineer Selection Process 2026 consists of shortlisting through GATE 2025 or GATE 2026 scores, followed by Group Discussion and Personal Interview. Candidates with a valid score in the corresponding GATE paper will be considered for shortlisting based on the normalised marks out of 100. The final merit will be prepared using the prescribed weightage for GATE, Group Discussion and Personal Interview.
